theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_bc_dilation_pullback_comp
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x y : Euclid P) (lam mu : ℝ), lam ≠ 0 → ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P lam) (-(lam⁻¹ • x)) (affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P mu) (-(mu⁻¹ • y)) ω) = affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P (lam * mu)) (-((lam * mu)⁻¹ • (x + lam • y))) ω
